mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter annualized signals stronger household demand, which typically boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and cost-push inflation, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% month-over-month signals stronger manufacturing activity and earnings growth, which typically drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 65% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -0.3% quarter-over-quarter annualized signals weakening household demand, which typically reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals a loosening labor market that reduces wage pressure and inflation, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 65% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below -0.5% month-over-month signals weakening manufacturing activity and earnings contraction, which typically drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year window.
